_note: C1-compatible pilot fixture; facts, known_false statements and Bloom metadata are temporary C4 test data (v2).

tree.name: Trees
facts: Tree nodes can be traversed using recursion.
known_false: A tree is a linear data structure.

binary_tree.name: Binary Trees
facts: A binary tree has at most two children per node.
A binary tree is a tree in which every node has at most two children.
known_false: A binary tree node can have any number of children.

heap.name: Heaps
facts: A heap is a complete binary tree.
A heap can be stored in an array.
known_false: A heap is a fully sorted array.
A heap is always fully sorted.

arrays.name: Arrays
facts: An array stores elements in contiguous indexed positions.
Array elements are accessed by index.
known_false: An array stores elements in random unrelated memory locations.

recursion.name: Recursion
facts: Recursion solves a problem by calling a function on smaller input.
Recursion needs a base case to stop.
known_false: Recursion never needs a base case.

stack.name: Stacks
facts: A stack follows the last-in-first-out rule.
A stack can be implemented with an array.
known_false: A stack follows the first-in-first-out rule.

queue.name: Queues
facts: A queue follows the first-in-first-out rule.
A queue can be implemented with an array.
known_false: A queue follows the last-in-first-out rule.

heap_is_sorted.description: Thinks that a heap array is fully sorted.
